title: Polypiler spec family 'machine'
description: The body under 'spec' of a document in spec/machine/: the machine profile of one instruction set, read by Polypiler.Core.MachineSemantics.ProfileLoader. Registers are roots (no parent) or sub-registers naming bits offset..offset+bits-1 of their parent, with the write policy 'preserve' (the other bits of the root keep their value) or 'zero-extend' (the write replaces the root). Flags stand alone or name a bit of a status register. Rules the schema cannot state (PLY0046, the same rules as PLY4003 of the loader): layout, unique-name, parent-declared, sub-register-inside-parent, no-parent-cycle, flag-register-declared.

isa.description: The profile's ID: the file name, and what 'machine <id>' of MachineIR names.

interruptVectors.description: How many interrupt vectors the machine has; MachineTrap vectors lie in 0..interruptVectors-1.
